title: Raised Floor Double Cup Panel Lifter

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Raised Floor Panel Double Cup Lifter is an essential tool for professionals who work with raised floor systems in data centers, offices, telecom facilities, server rooms, and industrial environments. Designed with high suction strength and durable construction, this lifter ensures safe, smooth, and hassle-free lifting of raised floor tiles without any surface damage.


The Single Cup Lifter is perfect for regular maintenance and quick access to underfloor cabling and wiring. It is lightweight, easy to grip, and provides secure suction for lifting standard-size panels.


For heavier or larger raised floor tiles, the Double Cup Lifter offers twice the suction power and enhanced stability. Its dual rubber cups generate strong grip force, making it ideal for technical rooms and professional raised floor installation teams.


Built with non-marking rubber cups and ergonomic handles, both models offer superior control while minimizing hand fatigue during frequent use. Whether you're installing new floors or accessing underfloor systems, the Raised Floor Panel Cup Lifter delivers reliability, safety, and convenience — making it a must-have tool for any raised floor infrastructure.
